intro.en: Three groups: understanding pictures, creating pictures, and extracting information from documents, images, audio and video.
intro.ro: Teen group: tasveerein samajhna, tasveerein banana, aur documents, images, audio aur video se maloomat nikalna.

text.en: One or more labels for the whole image.
text.ro: Poori image ke liye ek ya zyada labels.

text.en: Labels with bounding boxes, so you get position and count.
text.ro: Bounding boxes wale labels, is liye jagah aur tadad milti hai.

text.en: A label for every pixel of the image.
text.ro: Image ke har pixel ka label.

text.en: Reads printed and handwritten text with its position.
text.ro: Chhapa aur haath se likha text us ki jagah ke saath parhta hai.

text.en: A caption is a sentence; tags are single words with confidence.
text.ro: Caption ek jumla hai; tags akele alfaaz confidence ke saath.

text.en: Answer free questions about an image together with text.
text.ro: Text ke saath image ke baare mein khule sawalon ke jawab dete hain.

text.en: Detects and compares faces; identification features need limited access approval.
text.ro: Chehre dhoondta aur muqabla karta hai; identification ke liye limited access ki manzoori chahiye.

text.en: Creates or edits images from a prompt; a mask limits an edit to one area.
text.ro: Prompt se images banata ya edit karta hai; mask edit ko ek hisse tak mehdood karta hai.

text.en: Analyzers turn documents, images, audio and video into fields with confidence.
text.ro: Analyzers documents, images, audio aur video ko confidence wali fields mein badalte hain.

text.en: Classification: "street". Detection: three cars, each with a box. OCR: "Bakery". Caption: "a narrow street with parked cars". A multimodal model answers "Is the bakery open?" from the sign.
text.ro: Classification: "street". Detection: teen gaariyan, har ek ka box. OCR: "Bakery". Caption: "a narrow street with parked cars". Multimodal model sign dekh kar "Is the bakery open?" ka jawab deta hai.

rows.ro: Photo ke baare mein khule sawal

rows.en: Fields from invoices, calls or videos
rows.ro: Invoices, calls ya videos se fields

remember.en: Generate = new pixels; analyze = facts about existing pixels.
remember.ro: Generate = naye pixels; analyze = maujooda pixels ki maloomat.

remember.en: Detection gives boxes; classification does not.
remember.ro: Detection boxes deta hai; classification nahi.

remember.en: Low confidence goes to a person for review.
remember.ro: Kam confidence insan ke paas review ke liye jata hai.

remember.en: Generated images carry content credentials that mark them as AI-made.
remember.ro: Generated images mein content credentials hote hain jo AI se banne ka nishan hain.

traps.en: OCR gives text; it does not know which number is the total. That is extraction.
traps.ro: OCR text deta hai; use nahi pata ke kaunsa number total hai. Woh extraction ka kaam hai.

traps.en: Detecting a face is not the same as knowing who it is.
traps.ro: Chehra dhoondna aur ye jaanna ke kis ka hai, ek baat nahi.
